decisions.question: Expose merge ineligibility as HTTP 422 and preserve fallback errors as generic SDK API errors
decisions.chosen: Expose merge ineligibility as HTTP 422 and preserve fallback errors as generic SDK API errors
decisions.reasoning: The request is syntactically valid but cannot be processed by the selected symbol-merge strategy; only merge_conflict needs a dedicated structured SDK class, while merge_base_unavailable and merge_ineligible remain branchable through RelayFileApiError.code.

decisions.question: Apply merge authorization to the target path as an ordinary fs:write mutation
decisions.chosen: Apply merge authorization to the target path as an ordinary fs:write mutation
decisions.reasoning: The endpoint mutates the existing live file, so it uses the same path-scoped bearer checks and effective target-file permission checks as PUT /fs/file.
